blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — PLDT continued to have Creamline’s number, dealing the erstwhile-unbeaten defending champion its first defeat, 25-19, 25-27, 25-23, 25-23, in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday night at Philsports Arena. Savi Davison brought out her A game anew with 22 points on top of 19 excellent receptions and eight digs to send the High Speed Hitters to their third straight win with a 3-2 record tied with Farm Fresh and Choco Mucho. “I think we have to be aware that we might drop a set to Creamline because they’re a very strong team.
